assertion.rationale: F2: the MCP auth gate only throws in backendMode 'cloud' and MLS_TOOL_BACKENDS is never set, so tool calls are accepted from callers whose identity is never established. F3: the Direct Line token endpoint mints tokens — which carry the MCP credential — to any caller whenever DIRECTLINE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS is unset or the Origin header is absent, with no boot-time check that the variable is even configured, so no process or device identification occurs before a usable credential is issued.

recommendation: Invert the MCP auth gate default to enforced-unless-explicitly-opted-out and resolve the token via Key Vault + UAMI. Make the Direct Line token endpoint refuse (500) when DIRECTLINE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS is unset and refuse (403) when Origin is absent, so a caller's identity is established before any credential is issued.
